title: eupatorium ornatum
intro: Eupatorium ornatum, commonly known as the Ornate Joe Pye Weed, is a flowering plant native to the southeastern United States. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antimicrobial properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of colds and fever. The therapeutic actions of Eupatorium ornatum include its ability to induce sweating, reduce fever, and relieve rheumatic pain. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
